environment.description: AWS Lambda function triggered by IoT Core rule action. The Lambda execution role has s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject, and s3:ListBucket permissions on the iot-device-telemetry-prod bucket with Resource: arn:aws:s3:::iot-device-telemetry-prod/*. The Lambda runs in a VPC with a NAT gateway for S3 access. IoT Core rule forwards all messages matching topic 'devices/+/telemetry' without filtering the device_id field against the MQTT client identity.

config.lambda_role_policy: Allow s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject, s3:ListBucket on arn:aws:s3:::iot-device-telemetry-prod/*
config.network: VPC with NAT gateway, S3 access via public endpoint through NAT
config.s3_bucket_policy: Allow lambda role full access, no additional conditions
